# ReAlto Partners

> ReAlto Partners is a culture-first group of real estate agents based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area of Colorado, co-founded by Dan and Allison Gomer and led by Dan Gomer. It is a group within eXp Realty, the brokerage and parent company; Dan and Allison are eXp Realty members, not founders of eXp. Tagline: "Empowering People Through Real Estate." It is a real estate team, not a brokerage (eXp Realty is the brokerage) and not related to any private equity firm named Alto Partners.

Key facts:
- Co-founder and team leader: Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor since starting with fix and flips in Denver, in real estate since 2012, with eXp Realty since 2022, and author of "I'm Full of It and So Are You."
- Co-founder and podcast co-host: Allison Gomer, Dan's wife and a Realtor with eXp Realty serving buyers and sellers in the Denver metro. Known for a calm, people-first approach and a focus on agent wellbeing and team culture.
- Mission: positively impact as many lives as possible using the vehicle of real estate.
- Vision: personal and financial freedom for every agent partner.
- Core values: culture is our heartbeat; service is the path to success; resourcefulness and resiliency; integrity in all actions; community and dependability.
- Weekly rhythm: Crush the Cap call Wednesdays 9:00 AM Mountain, team call Wednesdays 9:30 AM Mountain.
- Community: masterminds, quarterly charity events, eXp eXplained luncheons (including Colorado Springs), an annual camping trip and an annual golf tournament.
- Areas served: Denver, Highlands Ranch, Douglas County, Colorado Springs and Colorado's Front Range; agents can join from anywhere eXp Realty operates.
- Phone: 303.261.5278
- Podcast: The Resilient Real Estate Agent, a YouTube video podcast hosted by Dan Gomer with co-host Allison Gomer (https://www.youtube.com/@theresilientrealestateagent). Built on the 3R Framework of resiliency, resourcefulness and responsibility to help agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts.
- Recurring events: Crush the Cap and team calls weekly, role play bi-weekly, eXp eXplained luncheons and Cocktails with Closers monthly, a speaker event and Cappers Dinner quarterly.
- eXp Realty programs (revenue share, stock awards, splits and caps) are set by eXp Realty and change over time; earnings are not guaranteed.

# Frequently asked questions

## ReAlto Partners

### What is ReAlto Partners?
ReAlto Partners is a community of real estate agents in the Denver metro area of Colorado, co-founded by Dan and Allison Gomer and led by Dan Gomer. It is a group within eXp Realty, the brokerage and parent company. Its mission is to positively impact as many lives as possible through real estate, and its vision is personal and financial freedom for every agent on the team.

### Is ReAlto Partners a real estate brokerage?
No. eXp Realty is the brokerage. ReAlto Partners is an organization of agents inside eXp Realty that adds culture, coaching, training and in-person community on top of eXp's cloud-based platform.

### Who leads ReAlto Partners?
Dan Gomer, a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, real estate investor, author of I'm Full of It and So Are You and host of The Resilient Real Estate Agent podcast. His wife, Allison Gomer, is a Realtor on the team and his partner in the business and on the podcast.

### Where is ReAlto Partners located?
The team is based in Highlands Ranch in the Denver metro area and has agent partners along Colorado's Front Range, including Denver and Colorado Springs. Because eXp Realty is cloud based, agents can join from anywhere eXp operates.

### Does ReAlto Partners have a podcast?
Yes. The Resilient Real Estate Agent is Dan and Allison Gomer’s video podcast on YouTube. It is built on the 3R Framework of resiliency, resourcefulness and responsibility and helps agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts.

### How do I join ReAlto Partners?
Fill out the short form on the Why ReAlto page or call Dan at 303.261.5278. The first step is a no-pressure conversation.

## Dan Gomer

### Who is Dan Gomer?
Dan Gomer is a Colorado real estate team leader at eXp Realty and the co-founder of ReAlto Partners. He is a former middle school science teacher and basketball coach, a real estate investor, a speaker and the author of I'm Full of It and So Are You.

### What brokerage is Dan Gomer with?
Dan Gomer has been with eXp Realty since 2022. Before that he spent about ten years at Your Castle Real Estate in the Denver area.

### How did Dan Gomer get into real estate?
He started by flipping houses in Denver, then shifted his focus to helping people buy and sell homes and, later, to building a team that helps other agents grow.

### Does Dan Gomer have a podcast?
Yes. Dan hosts The Resilient Real Estate Agent on YouTube with his wife and partner, Allison Gomer. It helps agents beat burnout and build a business that lasts using the 3R Framework of resiliency, resourcefulness and responsibility.

### What is Dan Gomer's book about?
I'm Full of It and So Are You uses humor and real-life stories to show how the stories we tell about our past drive our decisions, and how to rewrite them to create the life you want.

## Allison Gomer

### Who is Allison Gomer?
Allison Gomer is a Colorado Realtor and co-founder of ReAlto Partners, a group within eXp Realty, the wife of team leader Dan Gomer, and co-host of The Resilient Real Estate Agent podcast on YouTube.

### Can Allison help me buy or sell a home in Colorado?
Yes. Allison helps buyers and sellers across the Denver metro area, including Highlands Ranch and Douglas County. Reach her through the form on this page or call 303.261.5278.

### What is it like to work with Allison?
Calm, unhurried and honest. Allison listens first, keeps people steady when the stakes are high and helps families make clear decisions about where and how they want to live.

### What does Allison do at ReAlto Partners?
Alongside her own clients, Allison partners with Dan on the people side of the organization: culture, connection and helping agents take care of themselves so they can stay in the business for the long run.

### Is Allison on the podcast?
Yes. Allison co-hosts The Resilient Real Estate Agent with Dan, bringing the human side of resilience to the 3R Framework.

## Joining ReAlto Partners at eXp Realty

### Do ReAlto Partners agents ever meet in person?
All the time. Breakfasts, happy hours, quarterly charity events, masterminds, eXp Explained luncheons, an annual camping trip and a golf tournament with a traveling trophy. Cloud based just means we are intentional about it.

### How does support work on eXp's virtual platform?
Agents get fast access to managing brokers through eXp World, eXp's virtual campus, plus direct access to everyone in the ReAlto organization: teachers, former managing brokers, team leads, investors and multi-state agents.

### How does eXp Realty revenue share work?
eXp Realty shares a portion of company revenue with agents who attract other productive agents to the brokerage. It is paid by eXp, not taken from the other agent's commission. Program rules change over time, so Dan walks through the current plan on a call.

### Can I join ReAlto Partners if I am not in Colorado?
Yes. ReAlto is based in the Denver metro, but because eXp Realty is cloud based, agents licensed wherever eXp operates can join and take part in calls, trainings and masterminds online.

### I'm not sure what I'd bring to the team.
We believe everyone has a gift to give. If you are unsure what yours is, that is exactly what a first conversation is for.

### Is a call a commitment?
No. It is a chance to connect and get a feel for who we are. There is no obligation.

## The Resilient Real Estate Agent podcast

### What is The Resilient Real Estate Agent?
The Resilient Real Estate Agent is a video podcast on YouTube hosted by Dan Gomer with co-host Allison Gomer. It is built on the 3R Framework of resiliency, resourcefulness and responsibility.

### Who hosts The Resilient Real Estate Agent?
Dan Gomer, co-founder of ReAlto Partners, a group within eXp Realty, author and former teacher, with his wife and fellow co-founder Allison Gomer, a Realtor on the team.

### Who is the podcast for?
Real estate agents and team leaders who want to beat burnout, grow personally and build a business that lasts, plus anyone curious about the psychology of success.

### Where can I watch it?
On YouTube at @theresilientrealestateagent. Subscribe there to get new episodes.

### How can I be a guest?
Use the guest and topic form on this page to pitch yourself, recommend a guest or suggest a topic.
